pr_metadata.title: docs(reference): record RDQM/Pacemaker strategic position and keep-as-is decision
pr_metadata.summary: Adds a sourced research write-up (data vs judgment) on RDQM versus Native HA, RDQM's RHEL kmod cadence, DRBD/Pacemaker ecosystem signals and the pcmk-ubuntu justification, and records the 2026-10-09 keep-as-is decision: Native HA is strategic, RDQM and Pacemaker/DRBD stay as completeness counter-options while IBM supports them.
pr_metadata.notes: Deliverable for logical-minds-foundry/.github#309 (Ref only: the PR tooling closes same-repo issues only, so #1436 is the lab-repo vehicle; #309 still needs the outcome in the #280 retrospective section 5, .github#283, and a closing comment). Docs-only: new docs/reference/rdqm-pacemaker-strategic-position.md; short framing statements on the docs-site Home and Architecture pages; the Reference page links the new note and the OS support matrix. The support matrix is deliberately untouched because #1405 is updating it for MQ 10.0.1. The MQ 10.0.1 announcement (AD26-0859) is JavaScript-rendered; its quotes come from the text the human pasted into #1405. vrg-validate is green.
